summary.oneLiner: Q4/FY26 marked a "decisive transformation" toward profitability over revenue growth: consolidated revenue flat YoY but EBITDA margin +100 bps both for quarter and full year, driven almost entirely by **Print ad-yield (pricing) gains** in English and Hindi mastheads. Management has deliberately cleaned up the loss-making portfolio — **discontinued OTTplay** (Digital) and **surrendered 6 loss-making Radio frequencies** — and says no further closure/exceptional losses are expected (ex-statutory labour-code items). Net cash remains robust, north of INR 1,000 cr; no capital return planned — cash earmarked for "businesses of tomorrow" (core print copies + Digital/Digicontent).

Management has deliberately cleaned up the loss-making portfolio — discontinued OTTplay (Digital) and surrendered 6 loss-making Radio frequencies — and says no further closure/exceptional losses are expected (ex-statutory labour-code items). Net cash remains robust, north of INR 1,000 cr; no capital return planned — cash earmarked for "businesses of tomorrow" (core print copies + Digital/Digicontent).
scorecard (consolidated, q4 fy26; fy26 f: Print (consol): op revenue INR 427 cr; op-EBITDA INR 97 cr (23% margin). Ad rev INR 313 cr (+10%); circulation INR 51 cr (+4%). FY26: op rev INR 1,500 cr (+8%); op-EBITDA INR 208 cr (14% margin); ad rev INR 1,148 cr (+8%).
Print English: Q4 ad rev INR 172 cr (+9%); circ INR 13 cr (+13%). FY26 ad rev INR 644 cr (+8%); circ INR 53 cr (−5%).
Print Hindi (HMVL): Q4 ad rev INR 142 cr (+12%); circ INR 38 cr (flat). FY26 ad rev INR 504 cr (+8%); circ INR 155 cr (flat).
Radio: Q4 op rev INR 43 cr; op-EBITDA −INR 7 cr. FY26 op rev INR 140 cr; op-EBITDA −INR 22 cr. Revenue declined on high prior-year event-led base + industry pressure.
Digital (Shine + Mosaic, restated for continuing ops, ex-OTTplay): Q4 op rev INR 39 cr (flat); op-EBITDA −INR 2 cr. FY26 op rev INR 155 cr (flat); op-EBITDA −INR 8 cr (−5% margin).

One-offs / exceptional items (FY26): Exceptional loss from continuing ops INR 114 cr + loss from discontinued ops INR 101 cr = INR 215 cr total (per analyst, mgmt confirmed magnitude). A large exceptional item is provision consequent to the new labour codes. Other income fell INR 50 cr (INR 218 cr FY25 → INR 168 cr FY26) due to MTM losses on treasury as bond yields spiked (10Y ~7%). HMVL "other operating income" jumped (~INR 32 cr, ~doubled YoY) due to AFE contract forfeiture revenue. HMVL prior-year print segment revenue restated down ~INR 6 cr (INR 673→667 cr) — reversal of OTTplay intersegment ad spend now in discontinued ops.
guidance (critical): No formal forward revenue/earnings guidance (stated policy).
No further exceptional / discontinued-ops losses expected from business cleanup — explicit "simple answer is no" — EXCEPT potential statutory impact from new labour codes if anything further arises.
OTTplay wind-down: only "very small"/marginal P&L residual in FY27 (servicing pre-31-Mar subscriptions, 1–6 month tails to ~Sep); but cash outflow to exit content/ISP/channel-partner contracts.
Ad yields: management "hopes & plans" to hold deal pricing "at a certain level and above, not below" — sustainability caveated by competitive reaction.
pipeline / order book: AFE (Advertising-For-Equity / barter) portfolio: mix of fully-matured, semi-matured and "under-baked" assets; actively monetized opportunistically ("active sellers, not desperate sellers"). New AFE acquisitions are non-cash (paid in ad space). New AFE bet: Assetvault Ltd (brand "AasaanWill") — INR 22 cr non-cash AFE investment, near-nil revenue so far.
segment detail: Print is the clear engine — growth led by yields/pricing, volumes broadly flat (tracking industry). Conscious copy-share investment in key markets (English circ copies +13% in Q4), financed by ad-yield gains; realization per copy up only marginally (competition-constrained).
Radio under structural sector pressure; high event-led base in PY hurt YoY; network footprint sharpened by surrendering 6 loss-making frequencies — all remaining frequencies now profitable.
Digital reset: OTTplay shut; remaining Shine + Mosaic roughly breakeven-negative, flat revenue. Group digital ambitions sit largely in Digicontent Ltd (outside HTML consol).
growth / optionality: Pricing power in print ad yields ("played out very beautifully this quarter") — key swing factor; structural durability uncertain.
Copy-share strategy = long-term reader base / advertiser value chain ("recruit new readers → value prop to advertisers → AFE onboarding → pricing").
AFE asset monetization track record (4–5 yrs) as recurring cash-flow optionality.
>INR 1,000 cr cash optionality for "businesses of tomorrow" / Digital.
margins & cost (newsprint): EBITDA margin +100 bps YoY (consol and Print).

Key headwind: rising newsprint costs, amplified by a weakening rupee and global supply-chain / trade-policy / geopolitical disruption — flagged by Chairperson as the near-term concern, managed via "cost discipline."
Radio margin negative; loss reduced via frequency surrenders.
capex: Not discussed as physical capex. OTTplay described as "not a capital-heavy business, no residual value." Investment framed as working/strategic capital into circulation copies + Digital, not plant capex.
capital allocation: No dividend / buyback / capital return — "there is none so far."
Board policy: deploy cash pile into "businesses of tomorrow" — core print (copy-share) + Digital (incl. Digicontent).
AFE: non-cash acquisitions; active divestiture to maximize value, "not desperate sellers."
Treasury = "patient capital," will ride out the yield curve (no forced sales despite MTM losses).
risks: Newsprint cost inflation + INR depreciation squeezing print margin.
Ad-yield sustainability vs competitive reaction (pricing not guaranteed structural).
Radio sector "under a lot of pressure" structurally; remaining stations need profit growth.
Treasury MTM exposure to rising bond yields (already −INR 50 cr other income hit).
Statutory/labour-code provisions could bring further exceptional items.
Large cash pile with no return policy = capital-allocation / value-trap concern raised by analysts.
management tone: Confident and reform-minded; multiple analysts congratulated mgmt for "finally" shutting unviable OTTplay & Radio frequencies ("better late than never"). CFO upbeat on print pricing ("played out beautifully"), candid that OTTplay "didn't work" despite Tier-2/3 distribution strategy and telco competition. Repeatedly deflected forward guidance. Defensive on cash return.
non-obvious points: HMVL "other operating income" spike (~+100% YoY, ~INR 32 cr) is AFE forfeiture revenue — non-recurring quality of earnings flag.
Other income drop (−INR 50 cr) is MTM treasury losses, not operational — should reverse if yields fall.
OTTplay intersegment reversal restated HMVL PY print revenue down INR 6 cr (accounting, non-operational).
Group's real digital growth vehicle is Digicontent Ltd, sitting outside the listed HT Media consol — optionality not visible in HTML numbers.
Assetvault/AasaanWill is an unrelated-looking estate/will-planning AFE bet (8+ yrs, ~nil revenue) — speculative.
challenges → beneficiaries: (none clearly identified — sector-internal cost/competition dynamics; no cross-company beneficiary call-out) ✅⭐
qoq log: First note in series — prior-quarter comparison to be appended next quarter.

themes.title: Media, entertainment & out-of-home advertising
themes.need: Digital-content, music-IP licensing and an advertising-recovery cycle underpin media - TIPSMUSIC on music IP; ZEEL/ENIL/RADIOCITY/BTML on broadcast/content; HTMEDIA/DBCORP/HMVL on print + digital; SIGNPOST/BRIGHT-tier and UFO on OOH/cinema. Ad-spend revival is the near-term swing factor.
themes.driver: Festive ad-spend recovery; music-licensing/streaming monetization; OOH inventory uptake.
